title: The lost flint
text: You find a fine piece of flint in the riverbed that belongs to no one, or to whoever comes for it.

options.text: Keep it and learn to work it.
options.note: {hero} found a good piece of flint and kept it.
{hero} traded a piece of flint to {other} for a favour.

options.text: Give it to the clan's knapper.
options.note: {hero} gave a fine piece of flint away, and {other} was glad.
